items.html: And now a reason must be given, why the light of Yesod and Malchut both rose up to Daat, above Tifferet. And indeed the reason is as follows: since it is the way of Yesod to rise to Daat, therefore now the light of Yesod rose to Daat, above Tifferet. And also to bind all six of the Vav Ketzavot together and bring them illumination from there.
